items.fdcDescription: Cream, fluid, light (coffee cream or table cream)
items.notes: Explicit destination review accepts USDA light fluid cream as the generic nutrition reference for plain dairy cooking cream specified at up to 20% milk fat. Exact fat percentage within that range, UHT treatment, stabilizers, thickeners, brand formulation, and recipe-specific dilution are not certified. Nutrition remains per 100 g of the retained fluid-cream record; Cook4Me does not infer serving mass or hidden concentration conversion.
